summary: Operational command tests retain 2,401 mission runs and every count, pagination and response-size assertion, while replacing a 250,000-claim background with deterministic SQLite work comparisons at 501 and 1,002 unrelated claims. Each warmed endpoint must keep full-scan steps unchanged and add at most 50 VM steps. Fixture inserts reuse prepared statements in one transaction. Performance reporting uses an injected query duration rather than intentionally slow SQL.

replay.detail: Test fixtures only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: Production endpoint queries and runtime rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or replicated-state changes.

downtime.detail: No runtime changes or restart required.
